summary: Cinematic UI/UX redesign verification on SecureFin. Backend regression PASSED (2/2 pytest tests, all critical auth+CRUD+2FA+reset flows). Frontend PASSED all 13 requested visual/animation checks including city sunset hero, Ken Burns zoom, dark gradient overlay, staggered hero copy, transparent→glass nav on scroll, hero CTAs, scroll-triggered section reveals, DashboardPreview parallax float widgets, animated auth orbs (light aurora), password eye toggle convention, login+9 sidebar routes regression, warm amber/gold/pink accents on dashboard, prefers-reduced-motion respected, no horizontal overflow, no app console errors.

tests_executed.hero_city_background: PASS - .hero-city + .hero-city-img + .hero-city-veil rendered; background-image URL contains 'kw7qbu1a_ChatGPT+Image...' asset; animation-name=heroKenBurns duration=26s
tests_executed.hero_staggered_copy: PASS - eyebrow 'Finance, with a stronger lock', H1 'Your money. / Secured by design.' (em warm gradient), paragraph 'Track your spending...', two CTA buttons, hero-trust row all render. Note: WordReveal wraps each word in a span with no space char in DOM; visually spacing is correct via margin. No 'undefined' text anywhere.
tests_executed.nav_glass_on_scroll: PASS - .landing-nav class 'landing-nav ' before scroll, 'landing-nav is-scrolled' after scrolling >40px
tests_executed.scroll_triggered_reveals: PASS - feature-section wrapper computed opacity=0 transform=matrix(1,0,0,1,0,30) while off-screen; after scrollIntoView opacity animates to ~0.98, transform to matrix(1,0,0,1,0,~0)
tests_executed.auth_orbs: PASS - 3 spans .auth-orb-1/2/3 present with animation-name authDrift1/authDrift2/authDrift3 respectively
tests_executed.auth_light_aesthetic: PASS - near-white background, dark ink 'Welcome back.' text visible; form controls unchanged
tests_executed.password_eye_toggle: PASS - initial type=password with svg.lucide-eye-off; after click type=text with class 'lucide lucide-eye' (no eye-off)
tests_executed.login_regression: PASS - admin@securefin.app / SecureFinAdmin!2026 → /app dashboard; all 9 sidebar routes navigate (Overview, Transactions, Investments, Subscriptions, Budgets, Analytics, Security center, Profile, Settings)
tests_executed.dashboard_accents: PASS - security-pill color rgb(255,210,122) [--gold], stat-orange stat-icon color rgb(255,181,107) [--amber], demo-banner svg color rgb(255,122,192) [--pink]
tests_executed.reduced_motion: PASS - with emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce'): hero-city-img animation-duration collapses to 1e-06s, auth-orb-1/2/3 durations all 1e-06s, cursor-aurora count=0 (CursorTrail returns null)
tests_executed.console_errors: PASS - Only benign 401 responses on /api/auth/me for unauthenticated landing page visits (expected, not app errors). No JS exceptions or component errors.

critical_code_review_comments: WordReveal component splits H1 into per-word spans with no space characters between them; text_content() reads as 'Yourmoney.Securedbydesign.' but visual layout is correct due to inline-block margins. Consider inserting a ' ' text node between words for a11y/screen-reader friendliness — nice-to-have, not a bug.

App.js at 367 lines is doing a lot (Landing, AuthPage, AppShell, Overview, RecordsPage, SecurityCenter, Profile, Settings, SearchResults all in one file with long single-line JSX). Not a regression, but worth splitting for maintainability.

prefers-reduced-motion is handled via global CSS *,*::before,*::after {animation-duration:0.001ms!important} + framer-motion useReducedMotion() branches in CursorTrail/RevealOnScroll/DashboardPreview — correctly stops Ken Burns and auth orb drift as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 review-request bullets verified live on preview URL. Cinematic hero + city asset load fine, glass nav toggles at >40px scroll, warm sunset palette (pink/gold/amber) applied only on stat-orange, security-pill, demo-banner, primary button gradient and CTA background — dashboard functionality untouched. Auth orbs added cleanly behind unchanged light aurora auth page. Reduced-motion fully respected. Backend endpoints (register, login, 2FA setup+verify, forgot/reset, dashboard, transactions/investments/subscriptions/budgets CRUD, analytics, /auth/me, logout) all return 200/expected codes. No action required from main agent.
